hero.title: Unlock Your Emotional Intelligence with AI
hero.subtitle: EQAI combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with evidence-based assessment tools to help you understand and develop your emotional intelligence.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: EQAIGlobal is dedicated to making emotional intelligence accessible to everyone. We believe that understanding and developing emotional intelligence is essential for personal growth, meaningful relationships, and professional success.
mission.cardTitle: Assessment guidance with a human frame
mission.cardText: EQAI connects assessment discovery, guided answering, and saved records while keeping diagnostic boundaries explicit.

whatIsEqai.title: What Are EQAI Assessments?
whatIsEqai.description: Our assessments combine psychological research with AI-powered analysis to provide personalized insights into your emotional intelligence. Each assessment is designed to help you understand your strengths and identify areas for growth.

whyMatters.title: Why It Matters
whyMatters.description: Emotional intelligence affects every aspect of life—from personal relationships to workplace dynamics. Higher EQ is linked to better mental health, stronger relationships, effective leadership, and greater overall life satisfaction.

whoFor.title: Who Is This For?
whoFor.description: Whether you're a professional seeking career growth, a parent supporting child development, or simply someone committed to personal growth, our assessments provide valuable insights tailored to your unique journey.

aiSupport.title: AI-Enhanced Evaluation
aiSupport.description: Our advanced AI algorithms analyze your responses to provide nuanced, personalized feedback. The technology adapts to your unique patterns, offering insights that go beyond traditional assessment methods.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: EQAIGlobal was founded on the belief that emotional intelligence is a fundamental skill that can be developed and strengthened. We combine decades of psychological research with modern AI technology to create assessments that are both scientifically rigorous and deeply personal.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.text: We envision a world where emotional intelligence is recognized as essential to human flourishing. By making high-quality EQ assessments accessible to everyone, we aim to foster greater empathy, understanding, and connection across all areas of life.

approach.heading: Our Approach
approach.text: Our assessments are grounded in established emotional intelligence frameworks while leveraging AI to provide personalized, actionable insights. We continuously refine our algorithms based on the latest research in psychology, neuroscience, and machine learning.

values.heading: Our Values
values.accessibility: Accessibility - EQ assessment should be available to everyone
values.science: Science - Our methods are evidence-based and rigorously tested
values.privacy: Privacy - Your data is protected and never shared without consent
values.growth: Growth - We believe in the human capacity for emotional development

donate.title: Support Our Mission
donate.intro: EQAIGlobal is committed to making emotional intelligence assessments accessible to everyone, regardless of their ability to pay. Your donation helps us continue providing free assessments to those who need them most.

impact.heading: Your Impact
impact.text: Every contribution helps us expand access to emotional intelligence tools and resources. Your support enables us to:
impact.point1: Provide free assessments to underserved communities
impact.point2: Invest in research and development of new assessment tools
impact.point3: Translate our assessments into more languages
impact.point4: Create educational resources about emotional intelligence

howToHelp.heading: How to Donate
howToHelp.text: We are currently setting up our donation infrastructure. If you would like to support our mission, please contact us directly. We appreciate your interest in helping make emotional intelligence accessible to all.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.intro: Have questions about our assessments? Interested in partnerships or research collaborations? We'd love to hear from you.
